features.description: crew_core package skeleton: Scenario type, decodeScenario, validateScenario and scenarioHash, plus a watch-scenario fixture equivalent to watch_scenario.ail
acceptance_criteria: ailang test passes in packages/crew-core on both engines
Fixture-equivalence test: decoded testdata/watch-scenario.json matches watch_scenario actors, resources and workerRecipe
Malformed scenarios (unknown recipe, missing resource, trait out of range, duplicate id, extra field) are rejected with named errors
features.notes: packages/crew-core: scenario.ail (crew_scenario/1 decoder, validator, config(scenario, policy), workerRecipe/projectName/purpose/resourceName, scenarioHash) + 16 named tests passing on interpreter and strict VM; _smoke, CHANGELOG 0.1.0, AGENT.md; publish --dry-run: no gates. examples/crew-lab/data/watch-scenario.json + scenario_equivalence.ail (make scenario-equivalence): identical config (consent, orders), actors, resources, rights, names and purposes vs watch_scenario.ail; a mutation check (trait + supply name) fails it. Deviation: crew-core pins social_dynamics 0.3.0 from the registry (identical content hash) because publish smoke staging copies a path lockfile (ailang#1773). Conversation issue prompts remain keyed by role in code (D2, later).

features.description: Move session, actor_policy, personality_host, conversations, codec and policy (decoder and scoring from reactions) into crew_core; Session takes a Scenario; remove modern() and the legacy scenario
acceptance_criteria: ailang publish --dry-run in packages/crew-core reports no gates
Peak RSS of check --package and verify --package each under 250 MB, recorded in evidence
git grep -nE 'watch_scenario|modern\(' packages/crew-core has no matches
Per-module --strict-bytecode result recorded (informational)
features.notes: crew_core now holds session, policy (decoder/scoring/choice from reactions), host_policy (authority/appraisal), actor_policy, personality_host, conversations, codec, scenario and example (generated from data/watch-scenario.json by tools/gen-example.sh, drift-checked). Session carries its Scenario; start(scenario, line) requires a host profile (watch-v2/watch-v3); modern() and the legacy two-crew scenario are gone; the captain id must be "captain". 73 crew_core tests pass on interpreter and strict VM (22 host-invariant tests ported from the legacy scenario: 18 mechanically, 4 rewritten for watch semantics: archive slots not materials, pilot competes for slots, block via a completion-time reservation fault because watch effects saturate). check 194 MB / verify 194 MB (gate 250; crew-lab was 351), check 1.3 s. publish --dry-run: no gates. Deviation: content_library/social_dynamics/decisions pinned from registry (identical hashes; ailang#1773).

features.notes: Pulled forward into M2 (legacy scenario removal required it): deleted viewer/terminal/journey/journey_presenter, legacy scenario/watch_scenario, play.ail legacy launch loop (252 lines left), bins crew-lab/crew-view/crew-play*/crew-journey*; test-cli/journey/play/watch.sh retired (journey UI flows; domain assertions covered by crew_core session tests); play-*.menu moved to recordings/retired. main.ail kept as crew-host (NDJSON protocol for parity controls and future Godot use); host recordings regenerated for watch-v2.
